label: Line Art
description: Outline-only treatments — the drawing carried entirely by its lines, with the white of the page doing the rest. What coloring pages, tattoo flash and engraved plates are all made of.

items.name: coloring-book-bold
items.text: clean bold black outlines of even weight on pure white, no shading and no grey, every enclosed shape large enough for a crayon

items.name: fine-liner-detail
items.text: fine technical-pen linework, dense hatching for form and nothing filled solid, the confidence of an architect's hand

items.name: mandala-symmetry
items.text: radial symmetric ornament, concentric bands of repeating motif, every ring closing perfectly on itself

items.name: botanical-plate
items.text: botanical plate linework — stem, leaf and seed head drawn to scale with a naturalist's restraint, hairline stipple for shadow

items.name: kawaii-outline
items.text: rounded friendly outlines, generous white space inside every shape, simple faces with two dots and a curve

items.name: single-line-continuous
items.text: one unbroken continuous line describing the whole subject, never lifting, crossing itself only where the form demands

items.name: engraved-plate
items.text: old encyclopedia engraving: parallel burin lines swelling to describe volume, cross-hatched shadow, no solid black

items.name: marker-doodle
items.text: loose felt-tip doodle, wobbling confident outline, small repeated marks standing in for texture
